description: Election Commission - Nominate N. N. B. Kottegoda as the member of the Matale Pradeshiya Sabha - Nominate Mr. M. L. M. Shahabeen as the member of the ward No. 7 Nooraniya Akkaraipattu Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in local government councils (Akkaraipattu Municipal Council and Matale Pradeshiya Sabha) due to resignations, under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the declaration of newly elected members to fill vacant positions, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
